resolution.note: ship reuses a clean fast PASS keyed by HEAD tree; explicit --base resolves to merge-base; tests in test/ci/ship.test.ts and test/fast-check.test.ts

title: Ship reuses a fast PASS for the same tree
body:
Source: lane report for #1170 (d9525dc, t-txxnmrb): `krn pr ship` now runs scripts/fast-check.ts before the push, and lanes already ran `npm run fast` before the commit; with one shared fast slot one run took 562 s, so each PR pays the wait twice.
Outcome: fast-check writes a PASS record keyed by the git tree hash of the checked worktree; ship skips its pre-push run when a PASS record for the HEAD tree exists, and prints "pre-push: fast PASS reused for tree <hash>".
Why: the pre-push gate must not double the slowest step of every lane.
Proof: a ship test with a PASS record for the HEAD tree records no fast-check call and pushes; with a record for another tree it runs fast-check.
Files: scripts/fast-check.ts, src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
